summary: A near-white (#fdfdfd) 1160x720 canvas with one huge black line of type, "Thinking..." in a neutral grotesque sans (Inter/SF-like, regular-medium weight, cap height ~120px), spanning x 218-934, baseline ~y405, with the g descender to ~y435. Top-right sits a small pill button "GIF" with a download-arrow icon (box ~1055,18,86,44), white fill, 1px very light grey border, fully rounded. The text and button never move. The motion is a looping swarm of small flat-illustrated butterflies (~15-35px), each with two-tone wings (upper and lower wings in different saturated colours: purple, pink, orange, yellow, teal, mint, sky blue), a white highlight dot on each wing lobe, a thin dark body and two antennae. A cycle runs ~4.3s and plays twice (0.3-3.15s and 4.7-7.6s): butterflies enter from the left of the word, flock onto the letters left to right until the glyphs are densely covered (peak ~1.0-1.7s and ~5.3-6.0s, with "Thinking" heavily covered and the dots partly), then lift off and drift up and to the right, fading and blurring as they recede (distant ones are translucent and soft), leaving the screen empty by ~3.2s and ~7.6s. Between swarms (3.2-4.65s) the frame holds plain text only; the butterflies flap (wings change silhouette frame to frame) and sit on top of the type.

criteria.check: Background is a flat near-white (#fdfdfd-ish) with no gradient, texture or vignette
Headline reads exactly 'Thinking...' (capital T, three periods)
Headline is solid near-black (#090909) on white, no outline or shadow
Headline is a neutral geometric/grotesque sans at regular-to-medium weight (not bold, not serif); stem width ~20px
Headline spans x ~218 to ~934 with the T's top at y ~283
Baseline sits at y ~405 and the g descender reaches y ~435
Headline is horizontally near centre of the frame (centre x ~576) and its vertical centre slightly above the frame middle (~y350)
The three trailing dots are filled circles ~22px across, evenly spaced ~37px apart, sitting on the baseline
Headline does not move, scale or change colour between the two moments
A small pill button sits in the top-right corner
Pill box is ~[1055,18,86,44], ~20px from top and right edges
Pill is white with a 1px very light grey border and fully rounded ends, no shadow
Pill label reads 'GIF' in dark grey sans ~15px, to the right of the icon
Icon is a thin down arrow landing on a short horizontal bar, drawn in dark stroke
At rest between swarms the frame shows only text and pill, no butterflies
Near the start only 1-3 butterflies are visible, near the left half of the word
Early in the cycle butterflies cluster at the left of the word (over 'Th', x ~200-450) while the right of the word is clear
The swarm spreads left to right across the word: at 0.5s it covers 'Th', by 1.0s it reaches the 'g'
At peak, dozens (50+) of butterflies sit densely on the letter shapes so the word reads as patterned with butterflies
At peak the butterflies concentrate on the glyph strokes (following the letter shapes), not as a random cloud over the whole frame
Butterflies are drawn on top of the black type (they occlude it)
Butterflies lift off the left letters first and drift up and to the right: at 2.5s the left of the word is clear while a flock rises above 'king'
Departing butterflies fly toward the upper right (y < 250, x 400-950)
By ~3.2s every butterfly is gone and the frame holds plain text until ~4.65s
The swarm cycle repeats: a second swarm builds on the word from ~4.7s, peaks ~6s and departs up-right by ~7.6s
Late in the second cycle only a few butterflies remain upper-right (e.g. one purple near x820,y105)
Each butterfly is a flat cartoon illustration: four rounded wing lobes, thin dark body, two antennae (structured, not photo)
Upper and lower wings of one butterfly are different colours (e.g. pink over orange, purple over blue)
Each wing lobe carries a small white highlight dot
Palette of wings includes purple, pink, orange, yellow, teal/mint and sky blue, all saturated
Wings have no dark outline stroke; shapes are flat fills with soft rounded edges
Butterflies vary in size, roughly 15px to 35px across
Some butterflies away from the word are translucent and blurred (depth fade), others crisp
Butterflies flap: a butterfly's wing silhouette changes (open vs folded) between nearby moments
Butterflies fade in/out with opacity at entry and exit rather than popping
Butterflies are rotated at varied angles (not all upright)
Pill does not move or change during the swarm
